        type RestrictionDecision = { decisionId: int, evidenceId: int, banned: bool }
        type Access = { actor: int, participation: Participation, decisions: List[RestrictionDecision], appeal: bool, appealDecision: int, fundedAwards: int, originalFundedAwards: int }

          actorId == a.actor and moderator and evidenceId > 0 and decisionId > 0 and a.participation == Allowed and
          not(a.decisions.some(d => d.decisionId == decisionId))
        pure def ban(a: Access, actorId: int, decisionId: int, evidenceId: int, moderator: bool): Access =
          { ...a, participation: Banned, decisions: a.decisions.append({ decisionId: decisionId, evidenceId: evidenceId, banned: true }) }

        SLOP token identity and the pinned swap route are checked by the receipt adapter. A paused token has no enabled purchase or burn. Burn transfers go only to the canonical dead address, and total supply is not modeled as decreasing.
      its Quint:
        pure def canPurchase(b: Buyback, purchaseRequest: PurchaseQuote): bool =
          b.phase == Arrived and purchaseRequest.spent == b.arrival and purchaseRequest.spent >= 25000000
            and M::validAmount(purchaseRequest.acquired) and M::positiveAmount(purchaseRequest.acquired)
            and purchaseRequest.slippageBps >= 0 and purchaseRequest.slippageBps <= 100
            and purchaseRequest.impactBps >= 0 and purchaseRequest.impactBps <= 300
            and purchaseRequest.receiver == b.outputWallet and not(purchaseRequest.tokenPaused)
            and purchaseRequest.spent <= 1000000000 and purchaseRequest.now >= b.clock
            and spentInWindow(b.purchaseSpends, purchaseRequest.now) + purchaseRequest.spent <= 5000000000
        pure def purchase(b: Buyback, purchaseRequest: PurchaseQuote): Buyback =
          { ...b, phase: Purchased, acquired: M::addAmounts(b.acquired, purchaseRequest.acquired), clock: purchaseRequest.now,
            purchaseSpends: b.purchaseSpends.append({ at: purchaseRequest.now, amount: purchaseRequest.spent }) }
        pure def canCommitBurn(b: Buyback, quantity: M::Amount, value: int, destination: str, tokenPaused: bool): bool =
          b.phase == Purchased and M::validAmount(quantity) and M::positiveAmount(quantity)
            and M::equalAmounts(quantity, M::subtractAmounts(M::divideAmounts(b.acquired, List(2)).quotient, b.burnCommitted))
            and value >= 5000000 and destination == "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD" and not(tokenPaused)
        pure def commitBurn(b: Buyback, quantity: M::Amount, value: int, destination: str, tokenPaused: bool): Buyback =
          { ...b, phase: BurnPending, burnCommitted: M::addAmounts(b.burnCommitted, quantity) }
        pure def canFinalizeBurn(b: Buyback, quantity: M::Amount, height: int, finalized: bool): bool =
          b.phase == BurnPending and M::equalAmounts(quantity, M::subtractAmounts(b.burnCommitted, b.burned)) and height > b.finalizedHeight and finalized
        pure def finalizeBurn(b: Buyback, quantity: M::Amount, height: int, finalized: bool): Buyback =
          { ...b, phase: Burned, burned: M::addAmounts(b.burned, quantity), finalizedHeight: height }
        pure def alwaysShareBounded(b: Buyback): bool = M::validAmount(b.income) and M::validAmount(b.committed) and M::compareAmounts(b.committed, M::divideAmounts(b.income, List(2)).quotient) <= 0
        pure def alwaysBurnBounded(b: Buyback): bool = M::validAmount(b.burned) and M::compareAmounts(b.burned, b.burnCommitted) <= 0
          and M::validAmount(b.burnCommitted) and M::validAmount(b.acquired)
          and M::compareAmounts(b.burnCommitted, M::divideAmounts(b.acquired, List(2)).quotient) <= 0
        pure def sometimesInTransit(b: Buyback): bool = b.phase == InTransit
        pure def sometimesRefunded(b: Buyback): bool = b.phase == Refunded
        pure def sometimesBurned(b: Buyback): bool = b.phase == Burned
    "Story: Continue without counting income or burns twice / A completed cycle preserves cumulative accounting and the journal" (new)
      its prose:
        Rolling exposure uses integer UTC milliseconds and a 86,400,000-millisecond window. Timestamps come from the trusted clock. The retained journal includes approvals, fees and unresolved holds.
        
        
        Discovered by the proof: cumulative acquired and burn-committed amounts must
        retain valid limbs. The rolling-window bound also needs every journal entry
        to have a positive amount and a timestamp no later than the observed clock.
        Otherwise an arbitrary invariant-satisfying state can hide future spending
        outside the current window and reveal it when the clock advances.
      its Quint:
        pure def canContinueCycle(b: Buyback): bool = b.phase == Purchased or b.phase == Burned or b.phase == Refunded
        pure def continueCycle(b: Buyback): Buyback =
          { ...b, phase: Ready, orderAmount: 0, order: 0, arrival: 0 }
        pure def alwaysWindowLimits(b: Buyback): bool = spentInWindow(b.bridgeSpends, b.clock) <= 5000000000
          and spentInWindow(b.purchaseSpends, b.clock) <= 5000000000
        pure def alwaysJournalPastAndPositive(b: Buyback): bool = b.clock >= 0
          and b.bridgeSpends.every(spend => spend.at >= 0 and spend.at <= b.clock and spend.amount > 0)
          and b.purchaseSpends.every(spend => spend.at >= 0 and spend.at <= b.clock and spend.amount > 0)
        pure def stepIncomeMonotonic(before: Buyback, after: Buyback): bool = M::compareAmounts(after.income, before.income) >= 0
          and M::compareAmounts(after.acquired, before.acquired) >= 0 and M::compareAmounts(after.burnCommitted, before.burnCommitted) >= 0
    "Story: Check bridge-native and direct-receipt boundaries / Bridge-native spending observes its own network ceilings" (new)
      its prose:
        The Solana order allowance is independent of ordinary fee-conversion gas. EVM inputs use integer gwei and Solana inputs use lamports. The same signed transaction also remains subject to the shared native reservations and replacement policy.

A fee already received in SLOP contributes its cumulative half-share directly to acquired SLOP. The shared receipt journal prevents counting either receipt twice. Local and foreign instances retain distinct stablecoin asset identities at the adapter boundary.

        pure def localFeeShare(received: int, alreadyCommitted: int): int =
          if (received >= 0 and alreadyCommitted >= 0 and alreadyCommitted <= received / 2)
            received / 2 - alreadyCommitted else 0
        pure def lawLocalShareBound(received: int, alreadyCommitted: int): bool =
          (received >= 0 and alreadyCommitted >= 0 and alreadyCommitted <= received / 2) implies
            localFeeShare(received, alreadyCommitted) + alreadyCommitted == received / 2
        pure def canSelectSource(b: Buyback, robinhood: bool): bool = b.phase == Off and b.receipts.length() == 0
        pure def selectSource(b: Buyback, robinhood: bool): Buyback = { ...b, sourceIsRobinhood: robinhood }
        pure def canReserveLocalShare(b: Buyback, amount: int): bool = b.phase == Ready and b.sourceIsRobinhood
          and amount >= 25000000 and amount <= 1000000000 and M::compareAmounts(M::addAmounts(b.committed, M::smallAmount(amount)), M::divideAmounts(b.income, List(2)).quotient) <= 0
        pure def reserveLocalShare(b: Buyback, amount: int): Buyback =
          { ...b, phase: Arrived, committed: M::addAmounts(b.committed, M::smallAmount(amount)), arrival: amount }
        pure def canReceiveSlopFee(b: Buyback, receipt: int, quantity: M::Amount, receivedAt: int, finalized: bool): bool = b.phase == Ready and b.sourceIsRobinhood
          and receipt > 0 and not(b.receipts.includes(receipt)) and M::validAmount(quantity) and M::positiveAmount(quantity) and receivedAt >= 20261112 and finalized
        pure def receiveSlopFee(b: Buyback, receipt: int, quantity: M::Amount, receivedAt: int, finalized: bool): Buyback =

          and M::validAmount(b.localSlopCommitted) and M::compareAmounts(b.localSlopCommitted, M::divideAmounts(b.localSlopIncome, List(2)).quotient) <= 0

      its prose:
        PRD section 6 changes displayed ticker notation only. Asset classification
        comes from the verified registry and token identity, never from a symbol's
        spelling. The adapter decodes the canonical stored symbol into its count of
        leading dollar signs and its remaining Unicode characters. It verifies that
        this is an exact decomposition, each list entry is one character, and the body
        is nonempty and no longer starts with a dollar sign. The model uses this decoded
        representation because the supported Quint subset does not split strings.
        Rendering joins the returned prefix and body characters; it never writes them
        back to the canonical symbol. Invalid decoding produces no ticker.
        
        
        Ticker notation does not alter integer amounts, asset identity, reward terms,
        or the existing formatting of dollar-denominated amounts. A prefix does not
        supply an exchange rate or a USD equivalent.
      its Quint:
        type TickerKind = NativeCoin | ApprovedStablecoin | ProjectToken
        type DecodedTicker = { canonicalSymbol: str, leadingDollars: int, body: List[str] }
        type TickerView = { available: bool, canonicalSymbol: str, prefixDollars: int, body: List[str], usdValuation: bool }
        pure def validTicker(symbol: DecodedTicker): bool = symbol.canonicalSymbol != "" and
          symbol.leadingDollars >= 0 and symbol.body.length() > 0 and
          symbol.body.nthOr(0, "") != "$" and symbol.body.every(character => character != "")
        pure def displayTicker(kind: TickerKind, symbol: DecodedTicker): TickerView = {
          available: validTicker(symbol), canonicalSymbol: symbol.canonicalSymbol,
          prefixDollars: if (validTicker(symbol) and kind == ProjectToken) 1 else 0,
          body: if (validTicker(symbol)) symbol.body else List(), usdValuation: false

            displayTicker(ProjectToken, symbol).prefixDollars == 1 and
            displayTicker(ProjectToken, symbol).body.nthOr(0, "") != "$"
        pure def lawNativeAndStablecoinHaveNoPrefix(kind: TickerKind, symbol: DecodedTicker): bool =
          (kind == NativeCoin or kind == ApprovedStablecoin) implies displayTicker(kind, symbol).prefixDollars == 0
        pure def lawCanonicalTickerIsUnchanged(kind: TickerKind, symbol: DecodedTicker): bool =
          displayTicker(kind, symbol).canonicalSymbol == symbol.canonicalSymbol and
            (validTicker(symbol) implies displayTicker(kind, symbol).body == symbol.body)
        pure def lawTickerIsNotUsdValuation(kind: TickerKind, symbol: DecodedTicker): bool =
          not(displayTicker(kind, symbol).usdValuation)
        pure def lawInvalidTickerIsUnavailable(kind: TickerKind, symbol: DecodedTicker): bool =
          not(validTicker(symbol)) implies not(displayTicker(kind, symbol).available) and
            displayTicker(kind, symbol).prefixDollars == 0 and displayTicker(kind, symbol).body.length() == 0
        pure val symbolValues = Set(

          { canonicalSymbol: "$$EPYH", leadingDollars: 2, body: List("E", "P", "Y", "H") },
          { canonicalSymbol: "SOL", leadingDollars: 0, body: List("S", "O", "L") },
          { canonicalSymbol: "ETH", leadingDollars: 0, body: List("E", "T", "H") },
          { canonicalSymbol: "USDC", leadingDollars: 0, body: List("U", "S", "D", "C") },
          { canonicalSymbol: "USDG", leadingDollars: 0, body: List("U", "S", "D", "G") },
          { canonicalSymbol: "", leadingDollars: 0, body: List() },
          { canonicalSymbol: "$$", leadingDollars: 1, body: List("$") }
        )

        # Implementation Points allocation
        
        This library formalizes PRD section 7's 13 November 2026 line-weight decision.
        Recipients are immutable actor IDs associated with unique accepted non-merge
        commits. The source adapter must exclude synchronization merges and already
        credited work, verify retained copies, and obtain complete line evidence.
        The returned allocation contains whole Points. Ties use increasing actor ID.
    "Story: Divide one work unit's fixed value between its implementation authors" (new story)
      its text:
        Changing recipients never increases the work unit's value. Complete zero-line
        changes use equal weights. Missing line evidence holds a multiple-recipient
        allocation. A sole verified author receives the entire score.
      its rules:

      its prose:

      its Quint:
        type Recipient = { actor: int, lines: int }
        type PointShare = { actor: int, points: int }
        pure def validRecipients(recipients: List[Recipient]): bool =
          recipients.length() > 0 and recipients.every(r => r.actor > 0 and r.lines >= 0 and
            recipients.select(other => other.actor == r.actor).length() == 1)
        pure def eligibleAllocation(total: int, recipients: List[Recipient], completeLines: bool, frozen: bool): bool =
          total >= 10 and validRecipients(recipients) and not(frozen) and
          (recipients.length() == 1 or completeLines)
        pure def lineTotal(recipients: List[Recipient]): int = recipients.foldl(0, (acc, r) => acc + r.lines)
        pure def allocationWeight(r: Recipient, recipients: List[Recipient]): int =
          if (lineTotal(recipients) == 0) 1 else r.lines
        pure def weightTotal(recipients: List[Recipient]): int =
          if (lineTotal(recipients) == 0) recipients.length() else lineTotal(recipients)
    "Story: Divide one work unit's fixed value between its implementation authors / Largest remainder preserves the fixed pool and resolves equal remainders by actor ID" (new)
      its prose:
        Only the remaining whole Points follow remainder order. A zero-line recipient
        receives no Points when another recipient has positive lines.
      its Quint:
        pure def floorShare(total: int, r: Recipient, recipients: List[Recipient]): int = {
          val denominator = weightTotal(recipients)
          if (denominator > 0) total * allocationWeight(r, recipients) / denominator else 0
        }
        pure def pointRemainder(total: int, r: Recipient, recipients: List[Recipient]): int = {
          val denominator = weightTotal(recipients)
          if (denominator > 0) total * allocationWeight(r, recipients) % denominator else 0
        }
        pure def floorTotal(total: int, recipients: List[Recipient]): int =
          recipients.foldl(0, (acc, r) => acc + floorShare(total, r, recipients))
        pure def remainderRank(total: int, r: Recipient, recipients: List[Recipient]): int =
          recipients.select(other => pointRemainder(total, other, recipients) > pointRemainder(total, r, recipients) or
            (pointRemainder(total, other, recipients) == pointRemainder(total, r, recipients) and other.actor < r.actor)).length()
        pure def allocatePoints(total: int, recipients: List[Recipient]): List[PointShare] =
          recipients.listMap(r => { actor: r.actor, points: floorShare(total, r, recipients) +
            (if (remainderRank(total, r, recipients) < total - floorTotal(total, recipients)) 1 else 0) })
        pure def pointTotal(shares: List[PointShare]): int = shares.foldl(0, (acc, share) => acc + share.points)
        pure def lawSingleRecipient(total: int, actor: int, lines: int): bool =

          allocatePoints(total, List({ actor: actor, lines: lines })) == List({ actor: actor, points: total })

          allocatePoints(total, List({ actor: 1, lines: 0 }, { actor: 2, lines: 0 })) ==

        paid timestamp's twelve-calendar-month anniversary, clamping an unavailable
        day to the last day of that month and preserving the time of day. It does

        pure def validSource(a: Accrual, payouts: List[Payout], period: int): bool = payouts.every(p =>

        pure def startMonth(a: Accrual, period: int, payouts: List[Payout], sourceDigest: str,

        pure def allRecords(a: Accrual): List[AccrualRecord] = a.records.concat(a.staged)
        pure def totalAccrued(a: Accrual): M::Amount = allRecords(a).foldl(M::zero, (sum, r) => M::addAmounts(sum, r.amount))
        pure def projectAccrued(a: Accrual, project: int): M::Amount = allRecords(a).foldl(M::zero,

        pure def poolCap(a: Accrual): M::Amount = M::multiplyAmounts(a.tokenUnit, M::smallAmount(2000000))
        pure def projectCap(a: Accrual): M::Amount = M::multiplyAmounts(a.tokenUnit, M::smallAmount(250000))
        pure def smaller(left: M::Amount, right: M::Amount): M::Amount =

        pure def payoutEligible(a: Accrual, p: Payout): bool = p.paid and p.stablecoin

          and not(p.team) and not(p.banned) and not(p.held) and referrerFor(a, p.project) > 0
        pure def nextAccrual(a: Accrual): AccrualRecord =

        # Referral distributor contract
        
        This specification owns the on-chain state separately from the publication
        Worker. It follows the pinned
        [`ReferralDistributor.sol`](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/blob/6b3b9d0b979f0608d87941f1146056a98513ffcf/contracts/evm/src/ReferralDistributor.sol)
        (lines 103–118, 151–166, 202–239, 251–319) and PRD section 11. It does not
        activate the deferred program. Token balances use arbitrary-length base units.
        The token adapter must prove exact transfers and the fixed canonical token;
        the Merkle adapter verifies the double-hashed account/cumulative leaf with
        sorted-pair proofs. A boolean supplied by a request is never such evidence.

    "Story: Keep owner and poster authority separate / Deployment fixes token, growth cap and spacing, with distinct owner and poster" (new)
      its prose:
        The contract permits a positive deployment growth cap. Production admission
        separately requires the approved cap of 2,000,000 tokens and the reviewed
        spacing. Configuration here represents immutable constructor arguments.
        Times are block timestamps in seconds. The rescue delay is 365 days; a root
        has no claim delay.
      its Quint:
        import money as M from "./money"
        type SequenceCheck = { next: int, valid: bool }
        pure val emptySequenceCheck: SequenceCheck = { next: 0, valid: true }
        type Epoch = { index: int, root: str, total: M::Amount, postedAt: int, voided: bool }
        type AddressClaim = { wallet: str, cumulative: M::Amount }
        type Distributor = { configured: bool, token: str, tokenUnit: M::Amount, epochCap: M::Amount,
          postSpacing: int, owner: str, pendingOwner: str, poster: str, paused: bool,
          now: int, deployedAt: int, lastUnpausedAt: int, epochs: List[Epoch], latestRootClaimed: bool,
          claims: List[AddressClaim], balance: M::Amount, deposited: M::Amount, paid: M::Amount,
          rescued: M::Amount, depositReceipts: List[int] }
        pure val rescueDelay = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60
        pure val emptyEpoch: Epoch = { index: -1, root: "", total: M::zero, postedAt: 0, voided: true }
        pure val initial: Distributor = { configured: false, token: "", tokenUnit: M::zero, epochCap: M::zero,
          postSpacing: 0, owner: "", pendingOwner: "", poster: "", paused: false,
          now: 0, deployedAt: 0, lastUnpausedAt: 0, epochs: List(), latestRootClaimed: false,
          claims: List(), balance: M::zero, deposited: M::zero, paid: M::zero, rescued: M::zero, depositReceipts: List() }
        pure def canDeploy(d: Distributor, token: str, tokenUnit: M::Amount, cap: M::Amount,
          spacing: int, owner: str, poster: str, timestamp: int): bool = not(d.configured)
            and token != "" and owner != "" and poster != "" and owner != poster
            and M::validAmount(tokenUnit) and M::positiveAmount(tokenUnit) and M::validAmount(cap) and M::positiveAmount(cap)
            and spacing >= 0 and spacing <= rescueDelay and timestamp > 0
        pure def deploy(d: Distributor, token: str, tokenUnit: M::Amount, cap: M::Amount,
          spacing: int, owner: str, poster: str, timestamp: int): Distributor =
          { ...d, configured: true, token: token, tokenUnit: tokenUnit, epochCap: cap, postSpacing: spacing,
            owner: owner, poster: poster, now: timestamp, deployedAt: timestamp, lastUnpausedAt: timestamp }
        pure def approvedGrowthCap(d: Distributor): bool = M::equalAmounts(d.epochCap, M::multiplyAmounts(d.tokenUnit, M::smallAmount(2000000)))
        pure def canTick(d: Distributor, timestamp: int): bool = d.configured and timestamp > d.now
        pure def tick(d: Distributor, timestamp: int): Distributor = { ...d, now: timestamp }
    "Story: Keep owner and poster authority separate / Ownership transfer is accepted by the pending owner and never merges signer roles" (new)
      its prose:
        A zero pending owner cancels a transfer. A new poster is neither the owner nor
        the pending owner. Rotating the poster does not change roots, paid claims,
        spacing or the rescue clock.
      its Quint:
        pure def canTransferOwnership(d: Distributor, newOwner: str, by: str): bool = d.configured and by == d.owner and newOwner != d.poster
        pure def transferOwnership(d: Distributor, newOwner: str, by: str): Distributor = { ...d, pendingOwner: newOwner }
        pure def canAcceptOwnership(d: Distributor, by: str): bool = d.configured and d.pendingOwner != "" and by == d.pendingOwner
        pure def acceptOwnership(d: Distributor, by: str): Distributor = { ...d, owner: by, pendingOwner: "" }
        pure def canSetPoster(d: Distributor, newPoster: str, by: str): bool = d.configured and by == d.owner
          and newPoster != "" and newPoster != d.owner and newPoster != d.pendingOwner
        pure def setPoster(d: Distributor, newPoster: str, by: str): Distributor = { ...d, poster: newPoster }
        pure def canPause(d: Distributor, by: str): bool = d.configured and by == d.owner and not(d.paused)
        pure def pause(d: Distributor, by: str): Distributor = { ...d, paused: true }
        pure def canUnpause(d: Distributor, by: str): bool = d.configured and by == d.owner and d.paused
        pure def unpause(d: Distributor, by: str): Distributor = { ...d, paused: false, lastUnpausedAt: d.now }
    "Story: Admit funded roots at sequential epochs / Only exact token deposits increase the balance" (new)
      its prose:
        This observation represents finalized token transfers to the distributor,
        including deposits made outside its own interface. The adapter deduplicates
        the exact transfer log, verifies token identity and observes the complete
        balance change. A pledge or mismatched asset adds nothing.
      its Quint:
        pure def canDeposit(d: Distributor, amount: M::Amount, token: str, receipt: int, finalized: bool): bool =
          d.configured and token == d.token and receipt > 0 and not(d.depositReceipts.includes(receipt))
            and finalized and M::validAmount(amount) and M::positiveAmount(amount)
        pure def deposit(d: Distributor, amount: M::Amount, token: str, receipt: int, finalized: bool): Distributor =
          { ...d, balance: M::addAmounts(d.balance, amount), deposited: M::addAmounts(d.deposited, amount), depositReceipts: d.depositReceipts.append(receipt) }
        pure def liveRoot(d: Distributor): Epoch = d.epochs.foldl(emptyEpoch,
          (selected, epoch) => if (not(epoch.voided)) epoch else selected)
        pure def highWater(d: Distributor): M::Amount = d.epochs.foldl(M::zero,
          (highest, epoch) => if (not(epoch.voided) and M::compareAmounts(epoch.total, highest) > 0) epoch.total else highest)
        pure def canPostRoot(d: Distributor, index: int, root: str, total: M::Amount, by: str): bool =
          d.configured and not(d.paused) and by == d.poster and index == d.epochs.length() and root != ""
            and M::validAmount(total) and M::compareAmounts(total, d.paid) >= 0
            and M::compareAmounts(total, M::addAmounts(highWater(d), d.epochCap)) <= 0
            and M::compareAmounts(M::addAmounts(d.balance, d.paid), total) >= 0
            and (liveRoot(d).index < 0 or d.now >= liveRoot(d).postedAt + d.postSpacing)
        pure def postRoot(d: Distributor, index: int, root: str, total: M::Amount, by: str): Distributor =
          { ...d, epochs: d.epochs.append({ index: index, root: root, total: total, postedAt: d.now, voided: false }), latestRootClaimed: false }
    "Story: Admit funded roots at sequential epochs / Voiding the latest unclaimed epoch restores prior live spacing and high water" (new)
      its prose:
        Only the owner may void, and only the latest epoch before any successful
        claim after its posting. Voided epochs retain their original indices and
        posting timestamps. Views select the latest nonvoided epoch. The next index
        is the complete history length, including voided slots.
      its Quint:
        pure def canVoidLast(d: Distributor, index: int, by: str): bool = d.configured and by == d.owner
          and d.epochs.length() > 0 and index == d.epochs.length() - 1
          and not(d.epochs.nthOr(index, emptyEpoch).voided) and not(d.latestRootClaimed)
        pure def voidLast(d: Distributor, index: int, by: str): Distributor =
          { ...d, epochs: d.epochs.listMap(epoch => if (epoch.index == index) { ...epoch, voided: true } else epoch) }
    "Story: Claim only the unpaid cumulative difference / The wallet signs a valid active-root claim and receives its exact difference" (new)
      its prose:
        The caller address is the Merkle leaf address. Transfers and state changes
        are atomic: a failed, false-returning or inexact token transfer reverts. The
        sum of claims cannot exceed the active declared total. The token's balance
        must cover the transfer. Already paid cumulative amounts survive roots,
        voids, pauses and key rotation.
      its Quint:
        pure def claimedBy(d: Distributor, wallet: str): M::Amount = d.claims.foldl(M::zero,
          (selected, claim) => if (claim.wallet == wallet) claim.cumulative else selected)
        pure def claimDifference(d: Distributor, wallet: str, cumulative: M::Amount): M::Amount =
          M::subtractAmounts(cumulative, claimedBy(d, wallet))
        pure def rawClaimable(d: Distributor, wallet: str, cumulative: M::Amount, proofRoot: str, verified: bool): M::Amount =
          if (liveRoot(d).index >= 0 and liveRoot(d).root == proofRoot and verified
            and M::validAmount(cumulative) and M::compareAmounts(cumulative, claimedBy(d, wallet)) > 0
            and M::compareAmounts(M::addAmounts(d.paid, claimDifference(d, wallet, cumulative)), liveRoot(d).total) <= 0)
            claimDifference(d, wallet, cumulative) else M::zero
        pure def canClaim(d: Distributor, wallet: str, cumulative: M::Amount, proofRoot: str,
          verified: bool, transferExact: bool, by: str): bool = d.configured and not(d.paused)
            and wallet != "" and by == wallet and M::validAmount(cumulative)
            and M::positiveAmount(rawClaimable(d, wallet, cumulative, proofRoot, verified))
            and M::compareAmounts(d.balance, claimDifference(d, wallet, cumulative)) >= 0 and transferExact
        pure def claim(d: Distributor, wallet: str, cumulative: M::Amount, proofRoot: str,
          verified: bool, transferExact: bool, by: str): Distributor =
          val amount = claimDifference(d, wallet, cumulative)
          { ...d, balance: M::subtractAmounts(d.balance, amount), paid: M::addAmounts(d.paid, amount), latestRootClaimed: true,
            claims: d.claims.select(old => old.wallet != wallet).append({ wallet: wallet, cumulative: cumulative }) }
    "Story: Claim only the unpaid cumulative difference / Rescue waits a full year after every post and unpause, even after a void" (new)
      its prose:
        The owner may rescue the entire remaining balance to a nonzero destination
        only when the contract is unpaused and the rescue timestamp has arrived.
        Voiding a recent root cannot shorten the delay. A zero balance needs no token
        transfer. A failed transfer reverts. Rescue does not erase claims or roots;
        later claim execution can fail for lack of balance. The raw contract
        `claimable` view checks proof and declared total, not pause or token balance,
        so the product must distinguish that estimate from present execution readiness.
      its Quint:
        pure def rescueAvailableAt(d: Distributor): int =
          val latestPost = d.epochs.foldl(d.deployedAt, (latest, epoch) => if (epoch.postedAt > latest) epoch.postedAt else latest)
          (if (latestPost > d.lastUnpausedAt) latestPost else d.lastUnpausedAt) + rescueDelay
        pure def canRescue(d: Distributor, destination: str, transferExact: bool, by: str): bool =
          d.configured and not(d.paused) and by == d.owner and destination != "" and d.now >= rescueAvailableAt(d)
            and (not(M::positiveAmount(d.balance)) or transferExact)
        pure def rescue(d: Distributor, destination: str, transferExact: bool, by: str): Distributor =
          { ...d, rescued: M::addAmounts(d.rescued, d.balance), balance: M::zero }
    "Story: Claim only the unpaid cumulative difference / Configuration, retained claims and complete balance accounting never change retroactively" (new)
      its prose:
        (only the heading)
      its Quint:
        pure def alwaysUnconfiguredEmpty(d: Distributor): bool = not(d.configured) implies
          d.owner == "" and d.pendingOwner == "" and d.poster == "" and d.token == ""
            and d.epochs.length() == 0 and d.claims.length() == 0 and d.depositReceipts.length() == 0
            and d.balance == M::zero and d.deposited == M::zero and d.paid == M::zero and d.rescued == M::zero
        pure def alwaysTimeValid(d: Distributor): bool = d.configured implies d.deployedAt > 0
          and d.now >= d.deployedAt and d.lastUnpausedAt >= d.deployedAt and d.lastUnpausedAt <= d.now
            and d.postSpacing >= 0 and d.postSpacing <= rescueDelay
        pure def alwaysEpochRecords(d: Distributor): bool = d.epochs.every(epoch => epoch.root != "" and M::validAmount(epoch.total))
        pure def alwaysRolesSeparate(d: Distributor): bool = d.configured implies d.owner != "" and d.poster != ""
          and d.owner != d.poster and (d.pendingOwner == "" or d.pendingOwner != d.poster)
        pure def alwaysMoneyValid(d: Distributor): bool = M::validAmount(d.balance) and M::validAmount(d.deposited)
          and M::validAmount(d.paid) and M::validAmount(d.rescued) and M::validAmount(d.epochCap)
          and d.claims.every(c => c.wallet != "" and M::validAmount(c.cumulative))
        pure def alwaysConserved(d: Distributor): bool = M::equalAmounts(d.deposited,
          M::addAmounts(M::addAmounts(d.balance, d.paid), d.rescued))
        pure def alwaysPaidMatchesClaims(d: Distributor): bool = M::equalAmounts(d.paid,
          d.claims.foldl(M::zero, (total, c) => M::addAmounts(total, c.cumulative)))
        pure def alwaysUniqueClaims(d: Distributor): bool = d.claims.every(c => d.claims.select(other => other.wallet == c.wallet).length() == 1)
        pure def alwaysSequentialEpochs(d: Distributor): bool =
          val checked = d.epochs.foldl(emptySequenceCheck, (acc, epoch) =>
            { next: acc.next + 1, valid: acc.valid and epoch.index == acc.next })
          checked.valid
        pure def alwaysEpochTimes(d: Distributor): bool = d.epochs.every(epoch => epoch.postedAt >= d.deployedAt and epoch.postedAt <= d.now)

            and journalEntry.epoch == p.prepared.epoch and journalEntry.day > 0 and journalEntry.day <= p.day

          attempt == p.currentAttempt and not(p.settledGas.some(cost => cost.attempt == attempt))
            and p.attempts.some(entry => matchesPendingAttempt(p, entry) and entry.day <= settledDay)
            and actualGas >= 0 and actualGas <= p.nativeHold and settledDay <= p.day

        distributor's entire lifetime, including in later roots and after a void.
        Changing the account's current wallet never moves a cumulative leaf, because
        the contract tracks claimed amounts per address. This lifetime rule comes from

        amount. A successful claim seals the active root. The owner may void only the
        latest unsealed root, restoring the prior live root without rewriting history.
        Neither pause, key rotation nor void can recover an earlier payment.

        recording a finalized claim. The deployed distributor has its own on-chain
        pause, which blocks executing new claims, as recorded by its finalized cache;
        this is distinct from stopping the poster. A pending claim can beat a pause. An observed owner void halts new posts until
